who: Teaching assistants and bootcamp instructors who must autograde untrusted student code (fork bombs, infinite loops, file snooping) without risking the grading server.
agent_work: For each submission the agent boots a fresh Celesto microVM, writes the student code and a test harness into it, compiles and runs it, reads the results, and writes a grade.
proof_output: /work/grade.json read back from the guest: {submission, score, verdict, feedback}.
